code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen=set(); out=[[0]*6 for _ in range(3)]
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        if grid[r][c]!=2 or (r,c) in seen: continue
        stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); pts=[]
        while stack:
          y,x=stack.pop(); pts.append((y,x))
          for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            q=(y+dy,x+dx)
            if 0<=q[0]<h and 0<=q[1]<w and grid[q[0]][q[1]]==2 and q not in seen:
              seen.add(q); stack.append(q)
        if len(pts)<4: continue
        top=min(y for y,x in pts); bot=max(y for y,x in pts); midx=round(sum(x for y,x in pts)/len(pts))
        # stem above means singleton above the three-wide bar
        above=sum(1 for y,x in pts if y==top); below=sum(1 for y,x in pts if y==bot)
        up = above==1
        row=min(2, max(0, int(((top+bot)/2)*3/h)))
        out[row][3 if up else 0]=1 if up else 3
    return out
'''
